title: Juice N Power Shock Rainbow Sweets 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Shock Rainbow Candy is a kaleidoscope of tangy fruit candies in a deliciously smooth shortfill e-liquid from Juice N Power. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mods and sub-ohm tanks .
